findings.expected: The duplicate contains everything the original shows, including the link card \"All subscriptions in table view\" on the Website Analysis tab (34 cards, same tabs and positions).

The copy has 33 cards against the original's 34 — the missing one is the link card (dashcard 29 in the original, link to the question \"All subscriptions in table view\"). All text cards, headings and the YouTube iframe card were copied.

findings.name: "Exit fullscreen" needs two clicks when the dashboard was loaded/reloaded while in fullscreen
findings.summary: Nothing happens. The page stays in fullscreen, the header still shows the \"Exit fullscreen\" button, and the address still ends in #fullscreen (the click only rewrites the filter parameters, e.g. adds product_category=Doohickey&Gizmo&Gadget&Widget). A second click on the same button then does exit fullscreen. Seen 3 times out of 3 with this sequence; entering fullscreen from the menu and exiting immediately, without a reload, works on the first click. (on /dashboard/1)
findings.expected: The dashboard leaves fullscreen on the first click: the left navigation bar comes back, the header shows \"Enter fullscreen\" again and #fullscreen is removed from the address.
findings.actual: Nothing happens. The page stays in fullscreen, the header still shows the \"Exit fullscreen\" button, and the address still ends in #fullscreen (the click only rewrites the filter parameters, e.g. adds product_category=Doohickey&Gizmo&Gadget&Widget). A second click on the same button then does exit fullscreen. Seen 3 times out of 3 with this sequence; entering fullscreen from the menu and exiting immediately, without a reload, works on the first click.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai and open https://5501-ieaktt3pj66aduas4qpqc.e2b.app/dashboard/1

Open the "Move, trash, and more…" (…) menu at the top right of the dashboard header and click "Enter fullscreen" (the address becomes …/dashboard/1?…#fullscreen and the left navigation bar disappears). Alternatively open /dashboard/1#fullscreen directly.
Reload the page (F5 / browser reload). The dashboard is still in fullscreen, with the "Exit fullscreen" shrink button in the header.
Click the "Exit fullscreen" button once.

findings.name: "Revenue and orders over time" plots a quantity sum as "Orders", contradicting the Count row in its own tooltip
findings.summary: The \"Orders\" series is a sum of a numeric column, not an order count: the tooltip shows Orders 3,215 for Q4 2026 while its own Count row says 904, and the per-quarter \"Orders\" values (260, 1.1k, 1.2k, 843, 2.6k, 4.4k, 3.2k, about 13,500 in total) contradict the 3,372 total orders shown by the \"Total orders by product category\" card on the same tab. The card's description (question payload) reads \"Cumulative revenue overlaid with number of orders placed each month\" while the plotted line is non-cumulative and bucketed by quarter. (on /dashboard/1)
findings.expected: The series labelled \"Orders\" should be the number of orders for the quarter, agreeing with the Count row of its own tooltip (904) and with the order counts the other cards on the dashboard report (3,372 orders in total).
findings.actual: The \"Orders\" series is a sum of a numeric column, not an order count: the tooltip shows Orders 3,215 for Q4 2026 while its own Count row says 904, and the per-quarter \"Orders\" values (260, 1.1k, 1.2k, 843, 2.6k, 4.4k, 3.2k, about 13,500 in total) contradict the 3,372 total orders shown by the \"Total orders by product category\" card on the same tab. The card's description (question payload) reads \"Cumulative revenue overlaid with number of orders placed each month\" while the plotted line is non-cumulative and bucketed by quarter.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open /dashboard/1 (tab "Overview").
In the card "Revenue and orders over time" (top left), hover the rightmost purple bar (x-axis "Q4 2026", bar labelled 3.2k).
Read the tooltip: "Q4 2026 / Revenue 53,898.26 +22.92% / Orders 3,215 -27.03% / Sum of Discount $497.73 / Count 904".
Compare the "Orders" number with the "Count" row of the same tooltip, then scroll to the card "Total orders by product category" and compare with its centre total (3,372).

findings.expected: The app should refuse a name that is only whitespace, keep the previous title in the header (as it does for a fully empty title, which is silently rejected), and tell the user the title could not be saved.

findings.name: A dashboard's only tab cannot be renamed: its chevron menu loses \"Rename\" when a single tab is left
findings.summary: With a single tab the chevron menu shows only \"Duplicate\": \"Rename\" is missing, the tab label's textbox is disabled, and clicking or double-clicking the label does nothing — so a one-tab dashboard's tab cannot be renamed from the UI at all, although the same control offers Rename as soon as a second tab exists (with the three-tab state the menu was Rename / Duplicate / Delete). (on /dashboard/10-agent15-tab1-title)
findings.expected: The tab's chevron menu should offer \"Rename\" for a dashboard with a single tab just as it does with several tabs, since the tab strip and the tab's name are shown either way.
findings.actual: With a single tab the chevron menu shows only \"Duplicate\": \"Rename\" is missing, the tab label's textbox is disabled, and clicking or double-clicking the label does nothing — so a one-tab dashboard's tab cannot be renamed from the UI at all, although the same control offers Rename as soon as a second tab exists (with the three-tab state the menu was Rename / Duplicate / Delete).
reproSteps: Open my dashboard https://5501-ieaktt3pj66aduas4qpqc.e2b.app/dashboard/10-agent15-tab1-title and click the pencil "Edit dashboard" button.
With more than one tab present, click the chevron next to a tab label: the menu shows Rename / Duplicate / Delete (screenshot of the three-tab state).
Delete the extra tabs so that only "Tab 1" is left (chevron > Delete, then Save, re-enter edit mode).
Click the chevron next to "Tab 1": the menu now shows only "Duplicate" — no Rename and no Delete.
Also confirm that clicking or double-clicking the tab label does not open a name field (its textbox stays disabled).

findings.name: After saving a custom visualization on a card, its "…" menu loses "Edit question" while the identical table card keeps it
findings.summary: The chart card's "…" menu contains only "Download results"; "Edit question" is missing, while the identical table card right next to it shows both "Edit question" and "Download results". After a reload the chart card's menu still has only "Download results", so there is no way from that card to reach its question. findings.name: With every value ticked, a multi-select dashboard filter offers no "Update filter" — only "Set to default"
findings.summary: As soon as all four values are ticked, 'Update filter' disappears and the only control left in the popup is 'Set to default' (which saves the selection as the dashboard's default rather than applying it as a view filter). The same happens with nothing ticked. So a user who wants to go from 'Widget' back to all categories has no apply action in the popup; they must use the small reset icon on the pill, which returns to the saved default, not to a chosen selection. (on /dashboard/1 (Overview tab, Product Category filter))
findings.expected: The pending selection can be applied, so the filter can be widened from one value to all values: the 'Update filter' button stays available for any non-empty selection, and the dashboard then shows every product category.
findings.actual: As soon as all four values are ticked, 'Update filter' disappears and the only control left in the popup is 'Set to default' (which saves the selection as the dashboard's default rather than applying it as a view filter). The same happens with nothing ticked. So a user who wants to go from 'Widget' back to all categories has no apply action in the popup; they must use the small reset icon on the pill, which returns to the saved default, not to a chosen selection.
